# Mangayomi Manga Reader attribution

AnimeWitcher's Manga reader UI/behavior is adapted from the Mangayomi reader
implementation at commit `698a32f45ce638264bbd7236dec24330e3933c64`.

Upstream project: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi

Mangayomi is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The adapted
reader keeps AnimeWitcher's own MangaChapter/MangaPage, account, progress,
offline chapter manifest, and Download Manager V2 data layers while reproducing
the reader modes, controls, preferences, gestures, display filters, double-page
behavior, and continuous/Webtoon interaction model.

Copyright remains with the respective Mangayomi contributors. Use and
redistribution of the adapted portions are subject to Apache-2.0.
